0022600229.text: The Timberwolves, 8-3 and first in the Northwest, host the Mavericks, 7-4 and ninth in the West, in Minnesota's 12th game of the season, with Minnesota riding a four-game win streak and Dallas on three straight wins. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Morez Johnson Jr. is day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and a game-time decision. The Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, most recently a 124-94 win in Dallas on March 30, 2026, and no games have been played yet this season.
